description: Phase B2 — build the Admin management console (src/pages/Admin.jsx, replacing the FEAT-001 placeholder) with three panels (manage vendors / moderate reviews / read-only all-orders), then delete the three src/data seed files after confirming zero remaining imports, and run the final full build + grep verification. Depends on FEAT-001 (guards/route/supabase client), FEAT-002 (VendorContext + categoryName), and FEAT-003 (all order/student consumers rewired).
steps: Replace the FEAT-001 placeholder src/pages/Admin.jsx with the real admin console (gated by RequireRole role='admin' in App.jsx). Use the app's stacked/tabbed layout convention; add src/pages/Admin.css following the per-page CSS pattern (Dashboard.css/Profile.css). Use the shared src/lib/supabase.js client and useAuth()/useVendors().

Admin panel (a) Manage vendors: list all vendors via supabase.from('vendors').select('*') (admin SELECT=all), annotate each with owner name/email via supabase.from('profiles').select('id, full_name, email') (admin may read any profile). Per vendor provide: Assign/change owner ('claim') -> supabase.from('vendors').update({ owner_id: <selected profiles.id> }).eq('id', vendorId) (pick a user by email); Toggle preorder_enabled -> .update({ preorder_enabled }); Edit store info (name, category, location_area, hours_open, hours_close, phone, logo_url, cover_url) -> .update({ ...columns }).eq('id', <SELECTED vendor id>) — parameterized by the selected vendor id, NOT currentVendorId; NEVER send rating/review_count. Render a lightweight admin row that reuses VendorCard's open/closed + preorder badges and the categoryName() label but NOT its <Link> click (inline controls). Re-fetch after writes to reflect changes.

Admin panel (b) Moderate reviews: supabase.from('reviews').select('id, vendor_id, author_name, ordered_summary, rating, text, created_at'), annotate with vendor name from the vendors list, and a per-review Delete -> supabase.from('reviews').delete().eq('id', reviewId) (admin DELETE policy). After delete, re-fetch (the reviews->vendor aggregate trigger self-corrects rating/review_count). No edit of review content.

Admin panel (c) View all orders (READ-ONLY): supabase.from('orders').select('code, vendor_id, status, pickup_name, subtotal, total, placed_at').order('placed_at', { ascending:false }) (admin SELECT=all). Display status, vendor (name via the vendors list), pickup name, code, totals, placed-at. NO status mutation (Phase C owns order writes).
Confirm the Admin nav link is present for admins (handled in Header by FEAT-001); if missing, ensure Header shows it.

Pre-deletion grep: search ALL of src/ for any remaining import from src/data/ (../data/vendors, ../data/reviews, ../data/studentSample and any symbol sourced from them: vendors, categories, locationAreas, categoryName, getVendor, getReviewsFor, ACTIVE_ORDERS, PAST_ORDERS, FAVORITES, PENDING_REVIEWS, PAST_REVIEWS). Fix any stragglers. Only when ZERO import statements remain, delete src/data/vendors.js, src/data/reviews.js, src/data/studentSample.js. Update the stale comment in src/components/ReviewsModal.jsx so it no longer references ../data/reviews.js (comment-only).

Final verification pass: run npm run build from the worktree root and confirm green. Confirm no secrets committed (git status shows no .env/.env.local; only .env.example tracked). Confirm @supabase/supabase-js stayed a dependency (^2.118.0). Grep src/ for leftover DEMO_MODE/PREVIEW_USER, sessionStorage.setItem('order-, and direct order/order_items writes (from('orders').insert/.update, from('order_items').insert) and confirm none remain.
acceptance_criteria: src/pages/Admin.jsx renders three working panels: manage vendors (claim owner_id, toggle preorder, edit store info parameterized by the selected vendor id, never rating/review_count), moderate reviews (list + delete), and a read-only all-orders view — all via the shared Supabase client under admin RLS, with no C# calls and no order-status mutation.
The admin vendor rows reuse VendorCard's badges/categoryName labeling but not its Link navigation.
src/data/vendors.js, src/data/reviews.js, src/data/studentSample.js are deleted and a repo-wide grep finds ZERO imports from src/data/.
No secrets are committed (only .env.example tracked); @supabase/supabase-js remains ^2.118.0.
findings:
DONE. Build green (exit 0, 13.21s) from the worktree root after the data-file deletions. All FEAT-004 verification passes: Test-Path for the three src/data files => False/False/False (deleted via git rm); git grep data/vendors|data/reviews|data/studentSample in src => no matches (exit 1); git grep from('orders').insert|from('orders').update|from('order_items').insert|DEMO_MODE|PREVIEW_USER|sessionStorage.setItem('order- in src => no matches (exit 1); git status shows NO .env/.env.local (only .env.example tracked, added in FEAT-001); @supabase/supabase-js stayed ^2.118.0 in package.json. Committed locally on branch phase-b-frontend (staged only FEAT-004's files + the three deletions; package.json/package-lock.json left unstaged per FEAT-002's note).

=== What was built ===
src/pages/Admin.jsx replaces the FEAT-001 placeholder with a tabbed console (Vendors / Reviews / Orders) + src/pages/Admin.css (per-page CSS pattern; reuses global .btn/.chip/.badge/.card/.input/.select). All data via the shared src/lib/supabase.js client under admin RLS; uses useAuth() for the signed-in label and useVendors() for categories/locationAreas/categoryName. On mount it runs a single Promise.all of four admin SELECTs: vendors.select('*'), profiles.select('id, full_name, email'), reviews.select('id, vendor_id, author_name, ordered_summary, rating, text, created_at'), orders.select('code, vendor_id, status, pickup_name, subtotal, total, placed_at'). A Refresh button + onChanged() re-fetch after every write.
  (a) Manage vendors: lists every vendor; each row shows the open/closed + pre-order global .badge styles (open/closed derived by a local isOpenNow mirroring VendorContext) and a categoryName() .chip — NO VendorCard <Link> (inline controls only, VendorCard not imported). Controls: Assign/change owner (select a profile by 'full_name · email' -> update { owner_id }); Toggle pre-order (update { preorder_enabled: !current }); Edit store (inline form -> update { name, category, location_area, hours_open, hours_close, phone, logo_url, cover_url }). Edit is parameterized by THAT row's vendor.id via .eq('id', vendor.id) — NOT currentVendorId — and NEVER sends rating/review_count/owner_id. Category/location selects are populated from useVendors() categories/locationAreas.
  (b) Moderate reviews: lists all reviews annotated with the vendor name (resolved from the loaded vendors list, not a join), each with a Delete -> reviews.delete().eq('id', id) then re-fetch (the DB aggregate trigger self-corrects vendor rating/review_count). No content editing.
  (c) All orders: READ-ONLY table (code, vendor name, pickup, status pill, subtotal, total, placed-at), newest first. No status mutation, no order/order_items writes anywhere — Phase C owns order writes. An explicit note states status is managed by the order service (coming soon).
Write errors are console.error'd and surfaced inline (setError) without throwing.

src/components/ReviewsModal.jsx: the stale ~line-8 comment that referenced ../data/reviews.js was rewritten to say reviews arrive via the `reviews` prop (no data-file reference). Then src/data/vendors.js, src/data/reviews.js, src/data/studentSample.js were deleted.

Admin nav link: already present in Header (FEAT-001, role==='admin' -> /admin). No Header change needed. Note: the Icon set has no 'refresh' glyph — the Refresh button uses the existing 'history' icon.
